stations.name: Plate fibre laser
stations.what: Every plate part: side panels, floor, walls, motor plates, arm plates, hub plates and gussets, bucket, deck, brackets.
stations.rate: 12 kW fibre laser on mild steel (makers’ cutting tables, typical): 6 m/min at 1/4", 4.2 at 3/8", 2.6 at 1/2", 1.5 at 3/4"; pierce and head move 0.5 to 2.5 s. 3,000 × 1,500 mm sheets, nests using 78 % (typical with common-line cutting), 60 s to swap the shuttle tables and start the next nest; the tower loads and sorts the other table while the laser cuts.

stations.name: Deburr and sort
stations.rate: Dual-head brush deburring and edge rounding, 1,100 mm wide, 3 m/min; a robot lays parts on the belt (8 s) and a second one stacks them at the exit.

stations.name: Tube laser
stations.what: Every tube part: cross tubes, cradle, arm tubes, cross beam, lugs, DOM pivot and hub tubes, the mast.
stations.rate: 4 kW tube laser on 1/4" wall: 3.5 m/min, 0.7 s a pierce; 14 s a piece to index the chuck and unload by robot (bundle loader in parallel).

stations.name: Angle line
stations.what: Every angle: the floor runs, back-wall angles, clips, cross-beam and deck angles.
stations.rate: CNC angle line (punch, mark, shear): 3 s feed, 1.4 s a hole, 1.5 s ink-jet part mark, 2.5 s shear, 4 s robot stacking (typical for L2×2 at 150 hits/min presses).

stations.name: Robot welding
stations.what: The weldments: the four hubs, the arm pivots, lift brackets, cross-beam lugs, the bucket, the deck frame and the mast.
stations.rate: 2 GMAW robots on a two-station positioner: 450 mm/min for a 6 mm fillet (typical at 280 A), 5.2 s a seam to approach, start, stop and clean the torch, 12 s for the handling robot to place a piece in the fixture, 10 s to index the positioner; both torches share a weldment, so arc time is halved.

stations.name: Pretreatment washer
stations.rate: Power-and-free overhead conveyor at 2 m/min, parts hung 300 mm apart: a station’s time is the length of conveyor one LifeTrac’s parts take, at that speed; the cure oven holds 20 min at 200 °C.

stations.name: Powder booth
stations.rate: Power-and-free overhead conveyor at 2 m/min, parts hung 300 mm apart: a station’s time is the length of conveyor one LifeTrac’s parts take, at that speed; the cure oven holds 20 min at 200 °C.

stations.name: Cure oven
stations.rate: Power-and-free overhead conveyor at 2 m/min, parts hung 300 mm apart: a station’s time is the length of conveyor one LifeTrac’s parts take, at that speed; the cure oven holds 20 min at 200 °C.

stations.name: Frame bolting
stations.what: The frame’s plates, angles, tubes, cradle and its 324 bolts:
stations.rate: Bolting by 2 robots with nutrunners and fed nuts and washers: 9 s a bolt to pick, feed, run down and torque to spec with the angle checked (typical for screwdriving robots with feeders); the two work at once.

stations.name: Shaft turning
stations.what: The wheel shafts and couplings, from bar:
stations.rate: Turn-mill with bar feeder and live tooling, robot unloading (typical cycles).

stations.name: Wheel-unit kitting
stations.rate: AS/RS goods-to-robot kitting: the store brings the tote to the port while the robot works; 20 s a pick with scan and count, 35 s for a heavy one (wheels, motors, engine).

stations.name: Wheel units on
stations.what: Bearings, shafts, couplings, motors, hubs and wheels:
stations.rate: Bolting by 2 robots with nutrunners and fed nuts and washers: 9 s a bolt to pick, feed, run down and torque to spec with the angle checked (typical for screwdriving robots with feeders); the two work at once.

stations.name: Cube laser
stations.what: The cube’s plates, skids and cage:
stations.rate: 6 kW combo fibre laser (plate bed and a rotary tube axis): 3.6 m/min at 1/4", 2.4 at 3/8", 1.5 at 1/2" (typical).

stations.name: Cube frame welding
stations.rate: 2 GMAW robots on a two-station positioner: 450 mm/min for a 6 mm fillet (typical at 280 A), 5.2 s a seam to approach, start, stop and clean the torch, 12 s for the handling robot to place a piece in the fixture, 10 s to index the positioner; both torches share a weldment, so arc time is halved.

stations.name: Cube powder and cure
stations.rate: A batch powder booth with its own cure oven (typical 30 min a batch).

stations.name: Power Cube build
stations.what: The engine, pump and everything on the cube:
stations.rate: Robot placing a part: 15 s for a light one (gripper change, pick, locate, hold), 35 s for a heavy one by the gantry or a 500 kg robot. AS/RS goods-to-robot kitting: the store brings the tote to the port while the robot works; 20 s a pick with scan and count, 35 s for a heavy one (wheels, motors, engine).

stations.name: Cube run-in test
stations.rate: 1 % fail and go to the engine bay off the line.

stations.name: Power Cube in
stations.rate: A 500 kg gantry lowers the 181 kg cube on its cradle.

stations.name: Manifold machining
stations.what: The valve manifold, from aluminium bar:
stations.rate: Horizontal machining centre with a pallet pool (typical).

stations.name: Valve assembly
stations.what: Valves, coils, flow valve and sensors on the manifold:
stations.rate: Robot placing a part: 15 s for a light one (gripper change, pick, locate, hold), 35 s for a heavy one by the gantry or a 500 kg robot.

stations.name: Valve block test
stations.rate: Hydraulic test stand at 3,000 psi with flow meter (typical).

stations.name: Hose cut and crimp
stations.rate: Hose cell: 8 s to measure and cut off the reel, 12 s a crimp end (robot loads the fitting and the die), 6 s projectile cleaning, 5 s laser marking, 4 s caps, 15 s handling.

stations.name: Hose proof test
stations.rate: Proof cabinet, 6 hoses a batch.

stations.name: Hydraulics plumbed
stations.what: The valve block and every hose:
stations.rate: Dual-arm robots with hose-routing grippers: the hardest step of the line to automate, so its cycle varies most (cv 0.08).

stations.name: Pin turning
stations.rate: Turn-mill with bar feeder, robot unloading (typical cycles).

stations.name: Induction hardening
stations.rate: Induction scan hardening to 50–55 HRC on the bearing surface: 5 mm/s scan, 15 s spray quench, 10 s robot handling; tempered in the inline oven behind it.

stations.name: Loader arms hung
stations.what: Both arms built and hung, the cross beam:
stations.rate: Bolting by 2 robots with nutrunners and fed nuts and washers: 9 s a bolt to pick, feed, run down and torque to spec with the angle checked (typical for screwdriving robots with feeders); the two work at once.

stations.name: Cylinder saw
stations.rate: CNC cold saw with infeed and outfeed: 15 to 35 s a cut (typical).

stations.name: Cylinder turning
stations.what: Caps, glands, pistons, rod ends and eyes:
stations.rate: Turn-mill with a loading robot (typical cycles).

stations.name: Cylinder welding
stations.what: Caps, ports, clevises and rod eyes:
stations.rate: 2 GMAW robots on a two-station positioner: 450 mm/min for a 6 mm fillet (typical at 280 A), 5.2 s a seam to approach, start, stop and clean the torch, 12 s for the handling robot to place a piece in the fixture, 10 s to index the positioner; one torch here.

stations.name: Cylinder assembly
stations.what: Seals, pistons, glands, rods into barrels:
stations.rate: Seal-installation robot with expansion cones and a torque head (typical).

stations.name: Cylinder paint
stations.rate: Robot spray booth with IR flash cure.

stations.name: Cylinder test
stations.rate: Hydraulic test bench.

stations.name: Cylinders pinned
stations.what: The four cylinders and their hose ends:
stations.rate: Robot placing a part: 15 s for a light one (gripper change, pick, locate, hold), 35 s for a heavy one by the gantry or a 500 kg robot.

stations.name: Bucket and platform
stations.what: The bucket, its pins and the folding platform:
stations.rate: Robot placing a part: 15 s for a light one (gripper change, pick, locate, hold), 35 s for a heavy one by the gantry or a 500 kg robot.

stations.name: Harness making
stations.rate: Fully automatic cut-strip-crimp-seal (4.5 s a wire with both ends), a robot inserting terminals into the housings (5 s a terminal), 60 s to tape and tie a branch, 90 s continuity and hipot.

stations.name: Controller build
stations.what: The node box, its boards, the handheld and the mast’s kit:
stations.rate: AS/RS goods-to-robot kitting: the store brings the tote to the port while the robot works; 20 s a pick with scan and count, 35 s for a heavy one (wheels, motors, engine).

stations.name: Controller test
stations.rate: Functional test fixture with a shielded radio box (typical).

stations.name: Controller wired
stations.what: The node box, harness, mast, antennas, cameras, beacon and E-stop:
stations.rate: Robot placing a part: 15 s for a light one (gripper change, pick, locate, hold), 35 s for a heavy one by the gantry or a 500 kg robot.

stations.name: Oil, fuel and first start
stations.rate: Automatic fill rig with vacuum bleed.

stations.name: End-of-line test
stations.rate: 2 % fail and go to the rework bay off the line.

stations.name: Audit and drive-off
stations.rate: Vision arch and the build record.
